metadata.description: The flat case: this package has no subpath entry points, so build-base is the sole writer of dist/packages/dbx-components-cli and `build` is simply its bundle plus the templates archive. The nested `npx nx run dbx-components-cli:build-base` command it used to shell out to is now a dependsOn edge, so this runs inside ONE Nx process and one task graph instead of spawning a second one that shares no scheduling or dedup with the first; `parallel: false` went with it, since a single command cannot race anything. `^build` moved onto build-base, where the compile that actually needs finalized upstream dist lives.

`^build`, not `^build-base`. @dereekb/* imports are remapped to the dist DIRECTORY, so TypeScript reads that directory's package.json `exports` -- and rollup writes `.` as {import, types} until that dependency's own `build` reorders it. The edge used to sit on the `build` wrapper that shelled out to this target; it belongs on the compile.
